reference_spoken: Proverbs three, verses five and six.
verse: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verse_spoken: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
prayer: Heavenly Father, I come to you this morning needing your direction.
I choose to trust you with all my heart, not only the parts I understand.
Where I cannot see the way ahead, be the light on my path.
Quiet the noise of my own worries so I can hear your gentle voice.
Guide my words, my choices, and the conversations I will have today.
Close the doors that are not from you, and open the ones that are.
Give me patience to wait when you say wait, and courage to move when you say go.
In every decision, big or small, I acknowledge you as my Lord.
Lead everyone praying with me today, and make our paths straight.
